LESSON: REPAIRING GARMENTS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.1: Repairing Garments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Repairing Garments. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Repairing Garments
2. Practise Repairing Garments at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Repairing Garments

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Repairing Garments
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Repairing Garments. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Repairing Garments at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Repairing Garments at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Repairing Garments
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Repairing Garments. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Repairing Garments using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Repairing Garments in the examples.
2. Explain Repairing Garments to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Repairing Garments.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Repairing Garments using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Repairing Garments important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Repairing Garments
2. Practise Repairing Garments at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Repairing Garments

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
